headline: Welltower (WELL) Earnings Beat Keeps Fair Value In Focus
summary: Welltower (WELL) has drawn fresh attention after reporting second quarter results that topped analyst revenue and funds from operations estimates, while also trimming full year earnings guidance and reaffirming its long running quarterly dividend stream. See our latest analysis for Welltower. Welltower’s share price has pulled back slightly in the past week, yet it still trades at US$243.57 after a strong run, with a 30.29% year to date share price return and a 49.02% total shareholder return...
